---
title: "Getting started"
guide-section: "User Guide"
---

Edit inputs in the LIC-DSF workbook, save it, then reload it in Python. Keep
loan terms and assumptions in Excel rather than mutating loaded objects.

## Install

From a local checkout:

```bash
uv sync --all-groups
```

Or add the package from GitHub:

```bash
uv add "lic-dsf @ git+https://github.com/Teal-Insights/py-lic-dsf"
```

Run scripts with `uv run`, or use a Jupyter kernel from that environment.

## Choose a loader

| Excel work | Load function |
|------------|---------------|
| Input 4/5, Ext, Macro, baseline | `load_core` |
| Domestic debt indicators | `load_domestic` |
| Input 6/7 and tailored stresses | `load_stress` |
| CI, triggers, market access | `load_rating` |
| Imported data and realism assumptions | `load_realism` |
| Probability covariates | `load_probability` |

Start with `load_core`. Later pages add only the loaders needed for their
Output sheet.

```python
from pathlib import Path

from lic_dsf.load import load_core
from lic_dsf.output import external_dsa_panel, public_dsa_panel

workbook = Path("data/lic-dsf-template-2025-08-12.xlsx")
macro, external, ext_base, pub_base = load_core(workbook)

external_dsa_panel(ext_base)  # Output 1-1
public_dsa_panel(pub_base)    # Output 1-2
```

Replace the sample path with your filled country workbook. Its sheet layout
must match the template generation supported by this library.

## Export Outputs 1–7

The shortest end-to-end path computes the panels and writes a **new sidecar
workbook**. It does not overwrite the LIC-DSF template.

```python
from lic_dsf.export import to_workbook_from_path

to_workbook_from_path(workbook, Path("outputs/panels.xlsx"))
```

Use `include={...}` to select sheet titles from
`lic_dsf.run.OUTPUT_SHEET_ORDER`. The full export also contains
`Output - Summary` and `Output Database`; these are separate from Output 7.

## Caveats

- Numerical results aim to match Excel. Report unexplained differences as bugs
  unless a page or demo identifies an intentional approximation.
- Renamed sheets or unsupported template vintages may fail or misalign years.
- The sidecar contains panel-style data, not the official chart chrome,
  translated labels, or VBA.
- MIT applies to the code, not to redistribution of the bundled template; see
  `NOTICE.md`.

For notebooks:

```bash
uv run jupyter notebook demo/baseline_dsa.ipynb
```

The demos resolve the repository root whether Jupyter starts at the repository
root or in `demo/`.
